request.description: Creates a transportation between two locations.
Returns a transportation by its id.
Replaces an existing transportation with the provided payload.

query.description: Field to sort by (id, code, name, city, country)

request.description: Creates a new location and returns the created resource.
Returns a location by its id.
Updates an existing location and returns the updated resource.
Deletes a location by its id.

query.description: (Required) Date of travel in ISO-8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). The route legs must operate on this day.

request.description: Returns all valid routes from the given origin to the given destination for the specified date. A valid route consists of up to 3 legs with exactly 1 flight, optionally 1 non-flight leg before and/or after the flight. Results are filtered by the operating day derived from the provided date.
